filepath.description: Filepath used for exporting the file

check_existing.description: Check and warn on overwriting existing files

export_import_convert_lighting_mode.description: Optional backwards compatibility for non-standard render engines. Applies to lights

gltf_export_id.description: Identifier of caller (in case of add-on calling this exporter). Can be useful in case of Extension added by other add-ons

export_use_gltfpack.description: Use gltfpack to simplify the mesh and/or compress its textures

export_gltfpack_tc.description: Convert all textures to KTX2 with BasisU supercompression

export_gltfpack_si.description: Simplify meshes targeting triangle count ratio

export_gltfpack_sa.description: Aggressively simplify to the target ratio disregarding quality

export_gltfpack_slb.description: Lock border vertices during simplification to avoid gaps on connected meshes

export_gltfpack_vt.description: Use N-bit quantization for texture coordinates

export_gltfpack_vn.description: Use N-bit quantization for normals and tangents

export_gltfpack_vpi.description: Type to use for vertex position attributes

export_gltfpack_noq.description: Disable quantization; produces much larger glTF files with no extensions

export_gltfpack_kn.description: Restrict some optimization to keep named nodes and meshes attached to named nodes so that named nodes can be transformed externally

export_format.description: Output format. Binary is most efficient, but JSON may be easier to edit later

export_copyright.description: Legal rights and conditions for the model

export_image_format.description: Output format for images. PNG is lossless and generally preferred, but JPEG might be preferable for web applications due to the smaller file size. Alternatively they can be omitted if they are not needed

export_image_add_webp.description: Creates WebP textures for every texture. For already WebP textures, nothing happens

export_image_webp_fallback.description: For all WebP textures, create a PNG fallback texture

export_texture_dir.description: Folder to place texture files in. Relative to the .gltf file

export_keep_originals.description: Keep original textures files if possible. WARNING: if you use more than one texture, where pbr standard requires only one, only one texture will be used. This can lead to unexpected results

export_meshopt_extension.description: Extension to use for meshopt compression

export_draco_mesh_compression_level.description: Compression level (0 = most speed, 6 = most compression, higher values currently not supported)

export_draco_position_quantization.description: Quantization bits for position values (0 = no quantization)

export_draco_normal_quantization.description: Quantization bits for normal values (0 = no quantization)

export_draco_texcoord_quantization.description: Quantization bits for texture coordinate values (0 = no quantization)

export_draco_color_quantization.description: Quantization bits for color values (0 = no quantization)

export_draco_generic_quantization.description: Quantization bits for generic values like weights or joints (0 = no quantization)

export_unused_images.description: Export images not assigned to any material

export_unused_textures.description: Export image texture nodes not assigned to any material. This feature is not standard and needs an external extension to be included in the glTF file

export_vertex_color_name.description: Name of vertex color to export

export_all_vertex_colors.description: Export all vertex colors, even if not used by any material. If no Vertex Color is used in the mesh materials, a fake COLOR_0 will be created, in order to keep material unchanged

export_active_vertex_color_when_no_mater.description: When there is no material on object, export active vertex color

use_mesh_edges.description: Export loose edges as lines, using the material from the first material slot

use_mesh_vertices.description: Export loose points as glTF points, using the material from the first material slot

use_active_collection_with_nested.description: Include active collection and nested collections

use_active_collection.description: Export objects in the active collection only

collection.description: Export only objects from this collection (and its children)

at_collection_center.description: Export at Collection center of mass of root objects of the collection

export_extras.description: Export custom properties as glTF extras

export_apply.description: Apply modifiers (excluding Armatures) to mesh objects -WARNING: prevents exporting shape keys

export_shared_accessors.description: Export Primitives using shared accessors for attributes

export_animations.description: Exports active actions and NLA tracks as glTF animations

export_frame_range.description: Clips animations to selected playback range

export_frame_step.description: How often to evaluate animated values (in frames)

export_sampling_interpolation_fallback.description: Interpolation fallback for sampled animations, when the property is not keyed

export_pointer_animation.description: Export material, Light & Camera animation as Animation Pointer. Available only for baked animation mode 'NLA Tracks' and 'Scene'

export_nla_strips_merged_animation_name.description: Name of single glTF animation to be exported

export_hierarchy_flatten_bones.description: Flatten Bone Hierarchy. Useful in case of non decomposable transformation matrix

export_hierarchy_flatten_objs.description: Flatten Object Hierarchy. Useful in case of non decomposable transformation matrix

export_armature_object_remove.description: Remove Armature object if possible. If Armature has multiple root bones, object will not be removed

export_leaf_bone.description: Append a final bone to the end of each chain to specify last bone length (use this when you intend to edit the armature from exported data)

export_optimize_animation_size.description: Reduce exported file size by removing duplicate keyframes

export_optimize_animation_keep_anim_arma.description: If all keyframes are identical in a rig, force keeping the minimal animation. When off, all possible channels for the bones will be exported, even if empty (minimal animation, 2 keyframes)

export_optimize_animation_keep_anim_obje.description: If all keyframes are identical for object transformations, force keeping the minimal animation

export_optimize_disable_viewport.description: When exporting animations, disable viewport for other objects, for performance

export_negative_frame.description: Negative Frames are slid or cropped

export_anim_slide_to_zero.description: Set all glTF animation starting at 0.0s. Can be useful for looping animations

export_bake_animation.description: Force exporting animation on every object. Can be useful when using constraints or driver. Also useful when exporting only selection

export_anim_single_armature.description: Export all actions, bound to a single armature. WARNING: Option does not support exports including multiple armatures

export_reset_pose_bones.description: Reset pose bones between each action exported. This is needed when some bones are not keyed on some animations

export_current_frame.description: Export the scene in the current animation frame. When off, frame 0 is used as rest transformations for objects

export_rest_position_armature.description: Export armatures using rest position as joints' rest pose. When off, current frame pose is used as rest pose

export_anim_scene_split_object.description: Export Scene as seen in Viewport, But split animation by Object

export_influence_nb.description: Choose how many Bone influences to export

export_all_influences.description: Allow export of all joint vertex influences. Models may appear incorrectly in many viewers

export_morph_normal.description: Export vertex normals with shape keys (morph targets)

export_morph_tangent.description: Export vertex tangents with shape keys (morph targets)

export_morph_reset_sk_data.description: Reset shape keys between each action exported. This is needed when some SK channels are not keyed on some animations

export_lights.description: Export directional, point, and spot lights. Uses "KHR_lights_punctual" glTF extension

export_try_sparse_sk.description: Try using Sparse Accessor if it saves space

export_try_omit_sparse_sk.description: Omitting Sparse Accessor if data is empty

export_gpu_instances.description: Export using EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing. Limited to children of a given Empty. Multiple materials might be omitted

export_convert_animation_pointer.description: Export TRS and weights as Animation Pointer. Using KHR_animation_pointer extension

export_nla_strips.description: When on, multiple actions become part of the same glTF animation if they're pushed onto NLA tracks with the same name. When off, all the currently assigned actions become one glTF animation

export_original_specular.description: Export original glTF PBR Specular, instead of Blender Principled Shader Specular

will_save_settings.description: Store glTF export settings in the Blender project

export_hierarchy_full_collections.description: Export full hierarchy, including intermediate collections

export_extra_animations.description:
Export additional animations.
This feature is not standard and needs an external extension to be included in the glTF file
